caption: You probably never noticed how often you bite your lip when you're thinking, what's behind that?
comments_seeded: Is lip biting just a habit or can it be linked to something else going on in our minds?
Sometimes I catch myself biting my lip when I'm reading or focusing on something, anyone else do that?
What do you usually do when you realize you're biting your lip, do you try to stop or does it just happen naturally?
It's interesting to think about how our body language and small actions can be associated with our mental state, isn't it?
Have you ever tried to pay attention to when you bite your lip and see if you can figure out what triggers it for you?
